_source.name: World Stress Map Database Release 2016
_source.citation: Heidbach, O., Rajabi, M., Reiter, K., Ziegler, M., WSM Team (2016): World Stress Map Database Release 2016. V. 1.1. GFZ Data Services.
_source.product: interpolated field: the distance-weighted circular mean of the A–C records within 450 km of each node
_source.grid: equal-area nodes about 250 km apart, in rows of constant latitude spacing
_source.note: `azimuth` is the mean SHmax orientation and the bar lies along it; `agreement` is the resultant length of the records behind it — 1 where they all point the same way, 0 where they cancel; `support` is how many C-quality records that is worth. A node with less than one is not drawn at all.
